concept: Systems Manager Patch Manager: scheduled fleet patching
tests: Which service automates scheduled patching of EC2 with compliance reporting.
expected: AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager — patch baselines, maintenance windows, compliance reporting. Triggers: "apply patches on a schedule", "track compliance", "avoid custom tooling".
why_not: CodeDeploy — application code deployment; EC2 Image Builder — golden AMIs, not patching a running fleet; Lambda — custom tooling.
